  • 英語名: JK Gakuen Seishun Hakusho Kamen Yuutousei “Miyuki”

あらすじ

“The most talented girl in school, beautiful, excelling in both academics and sports, with a bright personality that everyone loves.”

That was the reputation of Matsuzaka Miyuki.

I considered myself lucky to be in the same class as her, the flawless honor student, right from the start of the school year.

item.title: JK Ren'ai Shousetsuka ~Anata ga Oshieru H na Ren'ai Shinan~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Red Rebel
  • 発売日: 2013-05-24
  • スコア: 6.1899999999999995/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: JK恋愛小説家 ～アナタが教えるHな恋愛指南～
  • 英語名: JK Ren’ai Shousetsuka Anata ga Oshieru H na Ren’ai Shinan

あらすじ

I’m a student whose reasons for joining the literature club were basically arbitrary - since club participation was mandatory. But unlike the majority of other students, I didn’t become a ghost member. The reason was… to put it bluntly, a girl.

I show up at the clubroom almost every day to see the club president, Wakana Izumi - the only one there actually doing anything resembling club activities. The other guys probably haven’t noticed, but this literary girl president has a damn good figure. How did I manage to notice? It’s because when she’s writing novels, her guard is down; once she concentrates, she seems to lose track of her surroundings… maybe because of the heat, but she ends up undoing her uniform to a risqué degree, letting me savor that outstanding figure.

item.title: JK Shiiku ~Junpaku no Shojo ni Midara na Kioku o Ataeru Otoko~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Red Rebel
  • 発売日: 2013-03-22
  • スコア: 6.7299999999999995/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: JK飼育 ～純白の処女に淫らな記憶を与える男～
  • 英語名: JK Shiiku Junpaku no Shojo ni Midara na Kioku o Ataeru Otoko

あらすじ

After losing your beloved pet, you’ve been feeling down. On your way home, you stumble across a high school girl with amnesia.

You can’t just leave her there, so being the kind-hearted person you are, you take her back to your apartment.

That night, unsure of who she is or where to go, she offers the only thing she has—her body—as thanks for taking her in.
